paragraphs.text: Damia , Sage of Stone is a legendary gorgon wizard from an unknown plane.
Usually, gorgons haven't many allies. However, many seek out the gorgon sage Damia, whose breadth of magical knowledge rivals that of any archmage—and whose prices cut deep.

She is a bit of a riddle. Even if she lairs in a vault of lore, she owns few scrolls or tomes herself. She has access to a library of secrets, but she surrounds herself with bottles, jars, and powders. She is known to answer the queries of curious travelers, but she is also known for her statuary of petrification victims, composed of those who have thought of forcing secrets out of her.
